fsb: FSB is the internal counterintelligence agency of the Russian Federation and successor to the Soviet KGB.
FSB can also mean a federally chartered savings bank.
FSB means the same as Federal Security Bureau or Federal Security Service or federal savings bank.
fsh: FSH is a gonadotropic hormone that is secreted by the anterior pituitary and stimulates growth of Graafian follicles in female mammals, and activates the cells in male mammals that form sperm.
FSH means the same as follicle-stimulating hormone.
